subject: Post-demo: monthly burn corridor, procurement triggers, and approval contacts
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Jared Collins <jared@mayacorp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Oct 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: monthly burn corridor, procurement triggers, and approval contacts

Hi Jared — thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so product and procurement can move in parallel:

Summary from call:
- Primary workload: chat agents + semantic search (mixed traffic, average prompt length ~350 tokens; peak sequences up to 1,200 tokens).
- Expected user activity: pilot 500k tokens/day ramping to ~2.5M tokens/day within 90 days.
- Key success criteria: sub-200ms p95 gen latency for interactive flows and monthly cost < $30k for pilot phase.

Open items / asks (action owners in parens):
1) Confirm target monthly spend band for vendor qualification and PO threshold (Jared / Procurement) — we discussed $20k–$40k for initial commit.
2) Procurement path: do you require a 3rd-party SOW + PO, or is a single master services agreement (MSA) acceptable? Include estimated legal lead time (Procurement).
3) PO automation: who is the billing contact and can we accept a single PO from your central finance? If yes, please share name and email. (Procurement)
4) Timeline: ideal contract execution window for pilot start (you mentioned mid-November).
5) Attachments: attached a tailored cost sheet (redwood-pricing-estimate-MAYA-2314.xlsx) that maps to $/1M token buckets and latency profiles.

Next steps I propose:
- You: confirm monthly spend band and PO threshold by next Wed (11/03).
- Us: we’ll prepare a short SOW + pilot pricing quote and share a sample MSA redline if helpful.
- If Procurement prefers, we can schedule a 30-min procurement kickoff next week to align on invoicing and tax paperwork.

If helpful, I can also run a 2-week capacity pre-reservation to hold the GPU slots for the pilot while legal runs in parallel.

Thanks — Sergio

--
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Jared Collins <jared@mayacorp.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: MayaCorp Procurement <procurement@mayacorp.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Oct 2026 16:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: monthly burn corridor, procurement triggers, and approval contacts

Sergio — appreciated the demo and the clear next steps. A few quick clarifications from procurement and finance that will determine our PO cadence:

1) Monthly spend corridor: procurement is comfortable qualifying vendors for a $15k–$45k/month band without additional executive sign-off. Anything above $45k/month triggers VP-level approval. For the pilot we’re aiming for the lower half (roughly $20k–$30k).
2) Procurement path: standard practice here is an MSA + PO. We do prefer an SOW attached to the PO for project-specific milestones, but legal can sign an MSA with a permissive SOW template to shorten runtime. Expect legal review to be ~7–12 business days.
3) Billing contact: Diane Park (diane.park@mayacorp.com) handles POs. Finance requires PO number on all invoices and prefers net-30 payment terms.
4) Tax & vendor setup: procurement will need Redwood’s W9 and bank details — please include in the procurement kickoff.

We reviewed the pricing spreadsheet and the $/1M token rows look reasonable. A few follow-ups: can you confirm the unit price at the 1M token bucket if we commit to a 3-month pilot at $25k/month? Also curious if sustained caching for repeated queries can materially reduce token spend (we discussed prefix caching briefly).

Happy to do the procurement kickoff next Tue (11/02) at 10am PT. If that works, please send calendar invite and include legal/finance contacts.

Thanks — Jared

--
Jared Collins
Head of AI Products | MayaCorp
jared@mayacorp.com | +1 (206) 555-0188

Jared — Laura from Redwood. Thanks for the clear budget band and procurement expectations. Quick answers to your two pricing questions:

1) Unit price for 1M tokens with a 3-month pilot at $25k/mo:
- Base unit: $0.80 per 1M tokens (pilot discounted tier) — this assumes continuous batch-friendly routing and standard FP16 serving.
- If you enable our prefix KV caching for the chat flows and grant read-only access to the cache policy within the pilot, we typically see 15–25% token reduction for repetitive assistant prompts. With caching on, effective cost could fall to ~$0.60–0.68 per 1M tokens (depending on hit rates).

2) Billing cadence and PO handling:
- We can accept a single PO from Diane Park for the pilot period. Invoices will reference the PO and be net-30.
- For vendor onboarding: we will attach Redwood’s W9 and vendor form in the procurement kickoff (I’ll bring finance ops).

Procurement kickoff proposal (Tue 11/02 10:00 PT):
- Agenda: vendor setup checklist, required paperwork (W9, bank ACH), SOW template & PO numbering, timeline for legal review.
- Attendees we’ll bring: Laura Bennett (Finance Ops), Neha Kapoor (Sales Ops). Please confirm Diane and procurement distribution list can attend.

Attaching: pilot-pricing-examples.pdf (small visual of buckets)

Thanks — Laura
